Hello everyone. I got stuck with those models too. I unpacked ASSETS.DAT and got .pck files. There is 2 variants where you can find models:

1) In root folder vp\_is300\_04.dat

2) ...\\ASSETS\\resources\\vehicle\\vp\_supra\_98 (Where last one is folder with car name) and there is vp\_supra\_98\_g.pck

They are included in models.7z which i attached to this post.

I have try to export first one as assets and got vp\_is300\_04 (archive attached)

I got .tex converter to get textures. But i need models from this game. Thanks anyway!

[Models.7zUnavailable](https://reshax.com/applications/core/interface/file/attachment.php?id=8331&key=26cd579c36f4f57e2247eba625896694) [vp\_is300\_04.7zUnavailable](https://reshax.com/applications/core/interface/file/attachment.php?id=8332&key=33cfb72d23910cd6e809201fd163c23d)
